question: 每个大区销量最高的单品是哪个
sql:
WITH sales_by_region_sku AS (
    SELECT 
        o.region,
        p.sku_name,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY o.region, p.sku_name
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        sku_name,
        total_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_qty DESC) AS rn
    FROM sales_by_region_sku
)
SELECT 
    region AS 大区,
    sku_name AS 单品,
    total_qty AS 销量
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region

question: 哪些品牌的净销额占比超过百分之十
sql:
SELECT 
  p.brand,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS 净销额,
  SUM(s.net_amount) / SUM(SUM(s.net_amount)) OVER () AS 净销额占比
FROM fact_sales s
JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
GROUP BY p.brand
QUALIFY SUM(s.net_amount) / SUM(SUM(s.net_amount)) OVER () > 0.10
ORDER BY 净销额占比 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 有多少家终端的净销额高于所有终端的平均水平
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS 终端数
FROM (
    SELECT s.outlet_id
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY s.outlet_id
    HAVING SUM(s.net_amount) > (
        SELECT SUM(s2.net_amount) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT s2.outlet_id), 0)
        FROM fact_sales s2
        JOIN dim_date d2 ON s2.date_key = d2.date_key
        WHERE d2.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    )
) t

question: 每个品类销量最高的三个单品
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category,
    p.sku_name,
    SUM(s.qty) AS 总销量,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(s.qty) DESC) AS rn
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
  GROUP BY p.category, p.sku_name
)
SELECT category AS 品类, sku_name AS 单品, 总销量
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY category, 总销量 DESC

question: 2026年8月哪些品类的销量比7月增长了
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.category,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON s.sku_id = p.sku_id
    WHERE d.year_month IN ('2026-07', '2026-08')
    GROUP BY p.category, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    a.category AS 品类
FROM monthly_sales a
JOIN monthly_sales b 
    ON a.category = b.category 
    AND a.year_month = '2026-08' 
    AND b.year_month = '2026-07'

question: 各大区净销额及其累计占比，按销额从高到低

        SUM(s.net_amount) AS 净销额
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31'
    GROUP BY o.region
),
total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(净销额) AS 总销额 FROM region_sales
)

question: 哪些业务代表的拜访次数高于平均值

    JOIN dim_date d ON fv.date_key = d.date_key

question: 2026年8月各渠道的促销费用率是多少

question: 2026年8月库存周转天数最长的十个经销商
sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        s.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(s.qty) AS total_qty,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.date_key) AS sales_days
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY s.dealer_id, d.year_month
),
monthly_inventory AS (
    SELECT 
        i.dealer_id,
        d.year_month,
        SUM(i.qty_on_hand) AS total_qty_on_hand
    FROM fact_inventory i
    JOIN dim_date d ON i.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY i.dealer_id, d.year_month
)
SELECT 
    dl.dealer_name AS 经销商名称,
    mi.total_qty_on_hand / NULLIF(ms.total_qty / NULLIF(ms.sales_days, 0), 0) AS 库存周转天数
FROM monthly_inventory mi
JOIN monthly_sales ms ON mi.dealer_id = ms.dealer_id AND mi.year_month = ms.year_month
JOIN dim_dealer dl ON mi.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
ORDER BY 库存周转天数 DESC

question: 各大区2026年8月净销额相比去年同期的增长率
sql:
WITH current_month AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS current_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY dl.region
),
last_year_month AS (
    SELECT 
        dl.region,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS last_year_net_amount
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_dealer dl ON s.dealer_id = dl.dealer_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY dl.region
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(cm.region, lym.region) AS 大区,
    (cm.current_net_amount - lym.last_year_net_amount) / NULLIF(lym.last_year_net_amount, 0) AS 同比增长率
FROM current_month cm
FULL JOIN last_year_month lym ON cm.region = lym.region
ORDER BY 大区
LIMIT 10

question: 各渠道2026年8月的单店产出相比去年同期的变化
sql:
WITH current_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS current_net_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id) AS current_outlet_count
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2026-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
),
previous_period AS (
    SELECT 
        o.channel,
        SUM(s.net_amount) AS previous_net_amount,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.outlet_id) AS previous_outlet_count
    FROM fact_sales s
    JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN dim_outlet o ON s.outlet_id = o.outlet_id
    WHERE d.year_month = '2025-08'
    GROUP BY o.channel
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(c.channel, p.channel) AS 渠道,
    (c.current_net_amount / NULLIF(c.current_outlet_count, 0)) - 
    (p.previous_net_amount / NULLIF(p.previous_outlet_count, 0)) AS 单店产出变化
FROM current_period c
FULL JOIN previous_period p ON c.channel = p.channel
ORDER BY 单店产出变化 DESC
LIMIT 10

question: 2026年上半年的费效比比2025年下半年高多少
sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(s.net_amount) AS amt
  FROM fact_sales s
  JOIN dim_date d ON s.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE s.is_promo
    AND d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY 1
),
c AS (
  SELECT d.year_month, SUM(pc.cost_amount) AS cost
  FROM fact_promo_cost pc
  JOIN dim_date d ON pc.date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30'
  GROUP BY 1
),
sc AS (
  SELECT s.year_month, s.amt / NULLIF(c.cost, 0) AS 费效比
  FROM s
  JOIN c USING (year_month)
),
periods AS (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN year_month >= '2025-07' AND year_month <= '2025-12' THEN '2025H2'
         WHEN year_month >= '2026-01' AND year_month <= '2026-06' THEN '2026H1'
    END AS period,
    费效比
  FROM sc
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2026H1' THEN 费效比 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN period = '2025H2' THEN 费效比 END) AS 费效比提升
FROM periods
